recipient-country.narrative: Gatsby Africa is a private foundation established by Lord David Sainsbury to accelerate competitive, inclusive, and resilient economic growth in East Africa by demonstrating how key sectors can be transformed. In East Africa, Gatsby Africa is working with sector actors across a diverse portfolio, including commercial forestry, to create inclusive opportunities, jobs, improved incomes and reduce poverty.

budget-line.narrative: UKPACT Project: UKPACT Project: Unlocking Private Investment in Commercial Forestry to Deliver on Kenya’s Climate Strategy

expense-line.narrative: Activity 1.Developing a roadmap to deliver sector vision, recommendations for policy makers and industry which will be subjected to impact analysis by experts, public private dialogue, study tours before dissemination materials to the public.

Activity 2. Working with Government of Kenya, Private sector and Civil Society to have a shared understanding of the benefits and requirements of an inclusive PPP framework for sustainable management of Public Plantations, leading to the development and ratification of PPP regulations.
Activity 3. Supporting and influencing Private landowners start to invest in commercial forestry at scale, in line with GoK targets. Enabled by quality support services and incentives.
Activity 5: Project coordination and day to day management, Government monthly check-ins and briefings. MEL and compliance.
Engaging with the sector to increase demand for sustainable timber by high employment manufacturing sectors
